sentences.text: No, the documents do not state that a 2% foreclosure charge on a fixed-rate term loan to a private limited company conflicts with the RBI pre-payment rules for UCBs; this case falls under the residual rule that, in cases other than those in paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.

The documents state that paragraph 261(1) covers floating rate loans for purposes other than business to individuals, and paragraph 261(2) covers floating rate loans for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises, so they do not state a specific restriction for a fixed-rate loan to a private limited company.
The documents do not state whether the approved policy of the UCB permits or prohibits a 2% foreclosure charge for this loan.
